conclusion: centered-objective training on the current ContactGrammar, at a 1200-step budget on the double-cold protocol with sequence + 2D inputs, does not produce protein-conditioned within-target ordering
not_concluded: that protein-conditioned architectures in general are impossible
that the data cannot support protein conditioning under any method
arm_matching_verified: configs differ in exactly protein_contrast_form and protein_contrast_loss_weight

P1_correct_ordering_improvement.requirement: lower bound above zero and mean >= 0.05

gates.secondary_gates: not formally evaluated; the preregistration evaluates them only if P1 passes

key_measurement.statement: correct and wrong protein give the same within-target ordering in both arms at every k

mechanism_observations.note: recorded because they name the cause; not gate evaluations

level_branch_excluded_as_designed.interpretation: float32 zero; centering removes protein_value(P) identically

protein_shift_seed_reproducibility.interpretation: the objective made the protein response consistent across independently seeded runs

protein_shift_alignment_with_truth.interpretation: the consistent response carries no affinity information; this is the preregistered P3 failure mode

no_material_regression.interpretation: all unresolved; the change is neither harmful nor useful

what_this_resolves.question: did no objective ever ask (a), or does the data not contain the signal (b)?
what_this_resolves.outcome: (a) is excluded. The objective asked at 4x weight on every episode through a verified gradient route, the model complied with a reproducible protein response, and the response carried no ordering information. Evidence shifts toward (b) without proving it.

cost.calibration_error: the 40-step probe excluded periodic validation passes

stop_rule_applied: P1 failed; the admission stage does not run and CPCpos/CPCwrong/CPCrand/A3perm were not trained
